the reception staff, doctors and nurses are usually friendly (unless completely snowed under), the extreme challenge of getting an appointment means I can't give better than 2 stars.

Their appointment system is the worst I've ever come across, and makes for a very stressful experience trying to get an appointment, which is the last thing you want when ill!

This morning, for example, they had no appointments left at 8.25am.. If this was just emergency appointments it woukdnt be an issue, but its impossible to book a doctors appointment in advance, so patients are left calling om a daily basis to get general appointments, completely destroying their phonelines in a morning and making everyone's lives harder..

It could be a good surgery, but whoever came up with their ludicrous appointment booking system has destroyed any hope of that.

I cannot recommend using this surgery.. for the sake if all involved... Not just the staff, but the existing patients and new patients too..

Updated to 1 star - If anything they've got worse. Avoid this place if you can.
